name: Asset Vision
description: Use Claude to connect to Asset Vision, ask questions using natural language and receive asset management insights. Enterprise Asset Management has never been this easy or intuitive before.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Asset Vision to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Asset Vision to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.assetvision.com.au/v2/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Asset Vision MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Asset Vision lists 31 MCP tools, including aggregate_joined, aggregate_spatial_nearest, aggregate_table, analyse_schedule, assign_inspection, assign_job, db_ping, get_about, get_current_user, get_dashboard, get_live_inspection, and get_live_job.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Asset Vision?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Asset Vision in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Asset Vision MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Asset Vision requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Asset Vision is developed by Asset Vision. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
